opportunities.title: Junior Scientist Conference Grant

deadlines.raw: 1st day of February, April, June, August, October and December

amount.raw: Scheme A up to £200; Scheme B up to £500 (or up to £750 for Adelphi co-sponsored); Scheme C up to £300

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Junior scientist members of the Genetics Society: Scheme A open to undergraduate, Master's and PhD student members and postdoctoral members within six years of PhD viva; Schemes B & C open to PhD student and postdoctoral members within six years of PhD viva. Applicants must present a poster or give a talk at the conference.
opportunities.summary: Supports attendance of Genetics Society junior scientist members at conferences on research in genetics, with three streams: (A) Genetics Society/SIG meetings, (B) non-Genetics Society meetings, and (C) virtual conferences.

opportunities.title: Training Grant
opportunities.eligibility_summary: All members of the Genetics Society studying or working in the UK, or attending a course held in the UK. Students can apply as soon as they become members; others should be members for at least one year.
opportunities.summary: Grants to enable members to attend formal short training courses, or a collaborative visit to another laboratory to train in specific genetic/genomic techniques.

opportunities.title: Heredity Fieldwork Grant
opportunities.eligibility_summary: All members of the Genetics Society studying or working in the UK, or intending to carry out fieldwork in the UK. Students can apply as soon as they become members; others should be members for at least one year.
opportunities.summary: Awards to cover travel and accommodation costs associated with a field-based genetic research project, funded by income from the Society's journal Heredity; research should produce results suitable for publication in Heredity.

opportunities.title: Carer's Award
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Any member of the Genetics Society, regardless of age of the person they are caring for; priority given to early-career scientists and according to need.
opportunities.summary: Award to support members with caring responsibilities to attend a Society meeting or event, used as the recipient thinks best supports their attendance.

opportunities.title: One-off Meeting Sponsorship

amount.raw: Several levels: a specific lecture for a few hundred pounds, a session up to about £1,000, or major sponsorship of an entire meeting (recently £1,000-£2,000)

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Members of the Genetics Society; meetings should be based in, or have strong links with, the UK.
opportunities.summary: Sponsorship of genetic-themed meetings not organised directly by the Genetics Society, towards the organisation of a meeting (not attendance).

opportunities.title: Public Engagement Grant
opportunities.summary: Grants to support public engagement activities related to genetics, delivered in person or virtually, covering eligible travel and materials costs (UK-based, budget/economy class).

opportunities.title: Special Interest Group (SIG) Funding
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Genetics research communities; meetings should be based in, or have strong links with, the UK.
opportunities.summary: Sponsorship of research meetings on particular themes for genetics research communities wishing to run regular series of meetings.
